gloss: misunderstanding; crossing paths, missing each other

definitions.gloss: crossing paths, passing each other, missing each other
definitions.explanation: The physical act of passing by someone going in the opposite direction or failing to meet due to different timing.
A failure to understand each other correctly, often due to different expectations or assumptions.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}で{行|い}き{違|ちが}いになった。
examples.english: We missed each other at the station.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}が{行|い}き{違|ちが}いするのを{待|ま}つ。
examples.english: Waiting for trains to pass each other.

examples.japanese: {約束|やくそく}の{時間|じかん}に{行|い}き{違|ちが}いがあった。
examples.english: There was a misunderstanding about the meeting time.

examples.japanese: メールの{行|い}き{違|ちが}いで{混乱|こんらん}が{生|しょう}じた。
{意見|いけん}の{行|い}き{違|ちが}いから{喧嘩|けんか}になった。
examples.english: A difference in opinions led to an argument.

examples.japanese: {行|い}き{違|ちが}いがあったようで、{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません。
examples.english: There seems to have been a misunderstanding. I apologize.

notes:
{行|い}き{違|ちが}い can refer to physical or communicative misalignment.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {行|い}き{違|ちが}いになる: to miss each other; to have a misunderstanding
- {行|い}き{違|ちが}いがある: there is a misunderstanding
- {行|い}き{違|ちが}いが{生|しょう}じる: a misunderstanding arises

RELATED WORDS:
- {食|く}い{違|ちが}い: discrepancy, disagreement
- {勘違|かんちが}い: misunderstanding, wrong assumption
- すれ{違|ちが}い: passing by; estrangement
